answer: A quill earns a seat in oasis only by burning glacier equal to the square of the live seat count, read fresh at commit. Influence is convex in attested tenure, so a farm cannot split one seat's tenure across clones or pool it; each clone needs its own full tenure and its own burn. The thousandth fake burns a million glacier, and a thousand fakes cost over 333 million glacier in total. The bill is glacier per seat, attached to each registration in oasis. It fails if tenure or seats become transferable.
